## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -9.45%) ↓ falling shows lower fear while sector breadth is weak (4/11), and SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -1.38%) indicates mixed internals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity/energy strength led by BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +18.38%) ↑ rising and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +2.17%) ↑ rising; fear easing via VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -9.45%) ↓ falling; credit roughly neutral as HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -0.08%) and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.20%) show no clear move.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -1.38%) vs TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.02%) — stocks showing short-term bounce while long-duration bonds remain under pressure and yield/dollar metrics are broadly flat.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Tech are the clearest pockets of strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +0.83%); Consumer Discretionary is weak with XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.02%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given 4/11 breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US slightly uneven: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -1.38%), Emerging Markets leading on breadth with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.08%), while China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.24% | 1M: -5.32%) remains weak.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Healthy speculative flows: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +22.25%), ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +31.40%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.78% | 1M: +5.12%) ─ VXX down supports risk tolerance.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity strength: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +18.38%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.36% | 1M: +19.10%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +2.17%) — energy and base metals leading.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing durable leadership: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%) with oil ETFs BNO/USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6–7% | 1M: +18–19%); natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.63% | 1M: -0.49%) is weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +0.83%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%) show two-way strength. DIVERGENCE: Minor — QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +1.23% | 1M: -0.63%), XBI CORRECTION (1W: -2.46% | 1M: +0.85%) and several grains (CORN/SOYB/WEAT CORRECTION) suggest mixed momentum.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Neutral posture: favor selective risk in energy and selective EM exposure — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.08%) showing strength; reduce exposure to consumer cyclical/industrial risk where XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.02%) and XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -6.94%) are weak; bonds remain mixed with TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.02%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%) if oil momentum persists. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary — XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.02%) and Industrials — XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -6.94%) on weak breadth.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +18.38%) and Copper — CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +2.17%). BEARISH: Natural Gas — UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.63% | 1M: -0.49%) and grain volatility on CORN/SOYB/WEAT CORRECTIONS.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health signal), XLK/XLF spread (watch a 1.0–2.0 pivot as growth vs value indication).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from VXX (BELOW TREND) versus weak sector breadth. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and select EM/crypto ETFs (EEM ABOVE TREND, IBIT ABOVE TREND) showing strength while consumer cyclicals and industrials (XLY, XLI BELOW TREND) are the main divergences to monitor.
